description: The plot illustrates the performance of three different methods, On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT, with respect to temperature, comparing their accuracy. The x-axis represents temperature, with a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 0.9, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents accuracy, measured as 'Pass@1', with a linear scale, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL line is depicted in orange with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 63.0 at a temperature of 0.1, fluctuating across the x-axis, and ending at approximately 78.0 at a temperature of 0.9, with a notable dip to around 65.0 at a temperature of 0.3. The LUFFY line is shown in blue with triangle markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.1, generally decreasing to around 70.0 at a temperature of 0.4, before rising to approximately 77.5 at a temperature of 0.7, and ending at around 80.0 at a temperature of 0.9. The SFT line is represented in red with star markers and a solid line style, starting at around 77.5 at a temperature of 0.1, generally increasing across the x-axis to around 82.5 at a temperature of 0.9, with some fluctuations, including a peak of approximately 82.5 at a temperature of 0.8.
